title: 第13章 “蓝色天使”
content_zh:
楚光将塑料袋的封口扎紧，继续说道。
“你们应该庆幸，没有继续往里面走，这种蘑菇通常生长在变异水蛭的巢穴附近。”
夜十愣了下。
“变异水蛭？”
楚光随口说道。
“嗯，幼年期的变异水蛭只有巴掌那么大，除了口器特殊之外，看起来和正常水蛭没什么区别。”
“然而一旦进入成年期，其尺寸会迅速增加至1米以上，最长甚至能到3米，其进食方式也会发生改变，听说甚至能一口吞下一个活人……当然，我也只是听说。”
听完管理者的叙述，夜十浑身上下一阵恶寒。
他就说当时采蘑菇的时候怎么感觉不对劲，但又说不上不对劲在哪儿。这么来看的话，自己原来是在鬼门关前溜了个弯。
“不能吃吗？”狂风脸上的表情颇为遗憾，看着被楚光收起来的蘑菇，嘀咕了一句，“我还以为可以加BUFF。”
“别想太多。”
哪有那么多BUFF。
有句话楚光没有说。
这玩意儿虽然不能吃，但却是制作消辐剂的主要原料。
具体原理楚光也不清楚，他也是从贝特街的老查理那里听说的。
蓝伞菇含有一种特殊的多肽类物质，能够有效缓解并治愈伽马射线造成的非致死性损伤。
巨石城的商队会收购这玩意儿，而且开出的价格还不低，通常是运到巨石城，卖给那里的工厂。
只不过这东西实在不好弄，很少有拾荒者愿意冒着生命危险去沼泽地或者地铁、下水道搜寻变异水蛭的巢穴。
不好找是一回事儿。
找到了没命带回来，又是另一回事儿。

就算是生活所迫，也没人愿意和这些吃人不吐骨头的触.手们打交道……
没想到近在咫尺的地方，居然就有一处变异水蛭的巢穴。
楚光心情喜忧参半。
喜的是这蓝伞菇能卖不少钱，忧的是变异水蛭可不好对付。
上哪儿弄几百公斤的盐去，有那么多盐不如直接卖盐。
这玩意儿一般都生活在潮湿地区，还真不是那么好点着的。
“你还记得那个下水道入口的具体位置吗？”
面对管理者的询问，狂风迅速掏出地图，指着上面做了记号的位置。
“就是这里。”
楚光看了一眼地图上的位置，将它默默记了下来。
“我知道了。”
狂风和夜十带回来的蓝伞菇估摸着有2公斤，一般行情每50g能换到一点筹码。
2000g就是40枚筹码！
这几乎相当于楚光过去五个月攒下的全部积蓄了。
而且这还是贝特街的回收站开出的价格。
这玩意儿的实际价值，至少也在这个数字的两倍以上！
楚光打算把这些蘑菇全都卖掉，再用换来的筹码购买前哨站急需的物资。
“前哨站的物资需要补充，我出去一趟，你们留在这里，记得不要走远。”
“下午五点，小柒会准时为你们
“我不在的时候，小柒会统计你们的工作成果，不懂的地方也可以问它。”

至于2公斤的蓝伞菇，楚光给狂风和夜十算了总共220贡献点。
其中200贡献点是因为发现了变异水蛭的巢穴，另外20贡献点是蓝伞菇的。
只给这么点真不是他抠门，而是怕给的太多，让这些玩家尝到了甜头，冒险跑去摘这玩意儿，一不小心死在了里面。
在找到能给“活性物质提取器”供电的发电机之前，他觉得自己还是谨慎一点比较好。
午饭吃的青麦煮粥。
说是粥，楚光倒觉得有点儿像没有甜味的绿豆汤。
这玩意儿没有什么味道可言，纯粹是为了填饱肚子。
不过让楚光意外的是，四名玩家却是吃的狼吞虎咽，犹如饿死鬼投胎。
有这么好吃吗？
楚光对自己的厨艺产生了怀疑。
难道我其实很擅长做饭？
不应该啊……
匆匆解决了一餐。
收起锅碗瓢盆，楚光灭了火堆，独自一人启程上路，疗养院里只剩下了四个玩家，和一个在楼上挂机的AI机器人。
方长盯着插在疗养院门口的任务板，陷入沉思。
夜十在一旁问。
“你在看什么呢。”
方长说道。
“根据管理者大人的说法，蓝伞菇可以作为制作抗辐剂的原料，但任务给你们的奖励却只有20点贡献，相当于砍两棵树……你觉得这合理吗？”
夜十愣了下。

“有什么问题吗。”
方长说道。
“当然有，正常来说，玩家从任务中得到的收益应该是与任务的难度成正相关的。你们不但解锁了新副本，还采集到了高价值物资，常理上来讲不至于只有这么点奖励。”
狂风思忖道。
“那你觉得是为什么。”
方长打了个响指。
“优先级！”
“优，优先级？”夜十愣道。
“没错。”方长点头，“你还记得之前剧情中，管理者说的话吗，当前的第一要务是生存！”
好像有吧。
夜十没听太仔细，大多数游戏他都是不看剧情，直接Ctrl过去的。这个游戏虽然不能Ctrl，但走神个几分钟也没区别了。
方长继续说。
“……所以我猜测，任务板上的任务并不是全部任务，这个游戏给了我们很大的自主权，任务不但可以由NPC发布，还能够主动触发。”
狂风皱眉道。
“理由？”
“你们不是已经收到奖励了吗？”方长说道，“虽然没有找到发电机，但发现了异种巢穴，并且采集到了有价值的物资。”
“所以我判断，只要我们的行为满足404号避难所的当前需求，就能够获得贡献点。并且奖励的数值，是和我们行为创造的价值是成正相关的！”
“比如修建粪坑和厕所，就是管理者采纳了我们的意见之后发布的任务，我和老白都拿到了200贡献点的奖励。”
老白点头。
“好像是这样的。”

“我大概懂你意思了，”狂风摸着下巴说道，“但完成任务板上的任务，不一样可以获得贡献点吗？”
而且点数还不低。
“这就是我要说的第二点了，”方长的脸上露出了神秘的笑容，“你还记得策划和我们说的好感度设定吗？”
狂风脸上浮起一丝恍然。
“原来如此……我明白你的意思了。”
夜十和老白仍然是一头雾水。
“你们到底明白啥了。”
“把话讲清楚啊！”
方长慢悠悠说道。
“简单来说，按部就班完成任务板上的固定任务，虽然能够获得固定的保底奖励，但无法展现我们的能力。相比之下主动触发任务，更能体现我们自己的能力！理论上来讲，应该能提升管理者对我们的评价。”
当然，这些推测都是基于废土OL是一款“完全真实”的沉浸式虚拟现实游戏，而管理者行为是由程序逻辑支配，非人为设定。
如果他的智能程度没有想象中的那么高，这个推断很可能就不成立了。
不过目前来看，管理者的智能程度还是挺高的，正常交流一点问题都没有，他甚至都忍不住要怀疑，这家伙会不会是真人扮演的了。
听懂了方长的解释，老白摸着下巴的胡子茬，点头说道。
“这个思路有点意思，值得尝试一下……那你觉得我们应该怎么做？”
“具体该怎么做，我也还在摸索中，不过直觉告诉我，相比起贡献点，在第二轮封测之前积累更多的NPC好感度更加关键，这能保证我们在第二轮封测拥有比其他玩家更高的‘起点’。”
顿了顿，方长打了个响指。
“我提议组队！”
“组队的意思是……”夜十疑惑道。
老白点头。

“我没意见。”
狂风也点了点头。
“我也赞同。”
夜十愣道。
“我也没意见，但可以和我说明一下组队的细节吗？”
方长耐心地解释道。
“简单来说，从现在开始我们是一支队伍，大家情报共享，互相帮助。再然后，我们要做的就是发挥各自的长处。”
方长看向狂风和夜十，继续说道。
“狂风，夜十，你们沿着湿地公园的湖岸侦查，注意观察异种分布情况，活动轨迹，如果发现疑似巢穴的区域标记出来……但水点。”
狂风点了点头。
“好的。”
接着，方长看向老白。
“至于我们，现在要做的是多砍点木头。”
“等一会儿下线了，我去网上查些资料，明天想办法把囤的这些木头给利用起来！”
content_en:
Chu Guang tightened the seal of the plastic bag and continued.
"You should be lucky that you didn't go further inside. This kind of mushroom usually grows near the nests of mutated leeches."
Ye Shi was stunned for a moment.
"Mutant leech?"
Chu Guang said casually.
"Well, juvenile mutant leeches are only as big as a palm. Except for their special mouthparts, they look no different from normal leeches."
"However, once it enters adulthood, its size will quickly increase to more than 1 meter, and it can even reach 3 meters in length. Its eating method will also change. I heard that it can even swallow a living person in one bite... Of course, I only heard that."
After listening to the manager's narration, Ye Shi felt a chill all over his body.
He just said that he felt something was wrong when he was picking mushrooms, but he couldn't tell what was wrong. Looking at it this way, it turned out that he had slipped past the gate of hell.
"Can't you eat it?" The expression on Kuangfeng's face was quite regretful. He looked at the mushrooms that Chu Guang put away and muttered, "I thought I could add BUFF."
"Don't think too much."
There are so many BUFFs.
There was something Chu Guang didn't say.
Although this stuff is not edible, it is the main raw material for making radiation abatement agents.
Chu Guang didn't know the specific principle. He also heard about it from old Charlie on Beit Street.
Blue mushroom contains a special peptide substance that can effectively alleviate and heal non-lethal damage caused by gamma rays.
The caravans in Boulder City will buy this thing, and the price they offer is not low. They usually transport it to Boulder City and sell it to the factory there.
It's just that this thing is really difficult to get, and few scavengers are willing to risk their lives to search for mutant leech nests in swamps, subways, and sewers.
It's one thing to be hard to find.
It's another thing to find it and bring it back alive.
Even if they are forced by life, no one wants to deal with these tentacles that eat people without spitting out bones...
Unexpectedly, there was a nest of mutated leeches so close at hand.
Chu Guang was in a mixed mood.
The good news is that the blue mushroom can be sold for a lot of money, but the bad news is that the mutated leeches are not easy to deal with.
Where can we get hundreds of kilograms of salt? It’s better to just sell the salt when there is so much salt.
This thing usually lives in humid areas, so it's really not that easy to light.
"Do you still remember the specific location of the sewer entrance?"
Facing the manager's inquiry, Kuangfeng quickly took out a map and pointed to the marked location on it.
"This is it."
Chu Guang glanced at the location on the map and silently memorized it.
"I understand."
The blue mushrooms brought back by Guangfeng and Yeshi were estimated to be 2 kilograms. Generally, in the market, every 50g can be exchanged for one chip.
2000g is 40 chips!
This is almost equivalent to all the savings Chu Guang has saved in the past five months.
And this is the price offered by the recycling depot on Beit Street.
The actual value of this thing is at least twice this number!
Chu Guang planned to sell all these mushrooms and use the exchanged chips to buy the urgently needed supplies for the outpost.
"The supplies at the outpost need to be replenished. I'll go out for a while. You guys stay here and remember not to go too far."
"At five o'clock in the afternoon, Xiaoqi will be there for you on time.
"When I'm not around, Xiaoqi will keep statistics on your work results, and you can ask her if you don't understand anything. "
As for the 2 kilograms of blue mushrooms, Chu Guang gave Kuang Feng and Ye Shi a total of 220 contribution points.
Among them, 200 contribution points were due to the discovery of the mutated leech's nest, and the other 20 contribution points were from the blue mushroom.
It's not that he's stingy about giving only this little, but he's afraid that giving too much will let these players taste the sweetness, risk running to pick this thing, and accidentally die in it.
Before finding a generator that could power the "Active Substance Extractor", he thought it would be better to be cautious.
lunchGreen wheat porridge.
Called porridge, Chu Guang thought it was a bit like mung bean soup without sweetness.
This thing has no taste at all and is purely for filling your stomach.
But what surprised Chu Guang was that the four players devoured the food as if they were reincarnated by starving ghosts.
Is it so delicious?
Chu Guang had doubts about his cooking skills.
Am I actually good at cooking?
It shouldn't be...
A hastily finished meal.
After putting away the pots and pans, Chu Guang put out the fire and set out on the road alone. There were only four players left in the sanatorium and an AI robot hanging upstairs.
Fang Chang stared at the task board inserted at the door of the nursing home and fell into deep thought.
Ye Shi asked from the side.
"What are you looking at?"
Fang Chang said.
"According to the administrator, blue mushrooms can be used as raw materials for making anti-radiation agents, but the reward given to you by the mission is only 20 contribution points, which is equivalent to cutting down two trees... Do you think this is reasonable?"
Ye Shi was stunned for a moment.
"Is there any problem?"
Fang Chang said.
"Of course there is. Normally, the benefits that players get from tasks should be directly related to the difficulty of the task. Not only have you unlocked new copies, but you have also collected high-value materials. Logically speaking, there should not be only such a small reward."
Guangfeng thought.
"Then why do you think it is?"
Fang Chang snapped his fingers.
"Priority!"
"Excellent, priority?" Ye Shi said blankly.
"That's right." Fang Chang nodded, "Do you still remember what the manager said in the previous plot? The first priority right now is survival!"
There seems to be.
Ye Shi didn't listen too carefully. In most games, he didn't read the plot and just pressed Ctrl to play. Although Ctrl is not supported in this game, it doesn't make any difference if you lose focus for a few minutes.
Fang Chang continued.
"...So I guess that the tasks on the task board are not all tasks. This game gives us a lot of autonomy. Not only can tasks be released by NPCs, but they can also be actively triggered."
Kuang Feng frowned.
"Reason?"
"Didn't you receive the reward?" Fang Chang said, "Although the generator was not found, the alien nest was discovered and valuable materials were collected."
"So I judge that as long as our behavior meets the current needs of Shelter 404, we can obtain contribution points. And the value of the reward is directly related to the value created by our behavior!"
"For example, building cesspools and toilets was a task issued by the manager after accepting our opinions. Lao Bai and I both received a reward of 200 contribution points."
Lao Bai nodded.
"It seems like that."
"I probably understand what you mean," Kuangfeng said, stroking his chin, "But don't you get contribution points by completing the tasks on the task board?"
And the points are not low.
"This is the second point I want to make," Fang Chang showed a mysterious smile on his face, "Do you still remember the favorability setting that the planner told us about?"
A hint of surprise appeared on Guangfeng's face.
"I see...I understand what you mean."
Ye Shi and Lao Bai are still confused.
"What on earth do you understand?"
"Speak clearly!"
Fang Chang said slowly.
"To put it simply, completing fixed tasks on the task board step by step can obtain fixed guaranteed rewards, but it cannot demonstrate our abilities. In contrast, proactively triggering tasks can better reflect our own abilities! In theory, it should improve managers' evaluation of us."
Of course, these speculations are based on the fact that Wasteland OL is a "completely real" immersive virtual reality game, and the behavior of managers is governed by program logic and is not artificially set.
If his intelligence is not as high as imagined, this inference may not be valid.
But at present, the intelligence of managersIt was still quite high, and there was no problem with normal communication. He couldn't help but wonder if this guy was played by a real person.
After understanding Fang Chang's explanation, Lao Bai touched the stubble on his chin, nodded and said.
"This idea is interesting and worth trying... So what do you think we should do?"
"I'm still figuring out how to do it specifically, but my intuition tells me that compared to contribution points, it's more important to accumulate more NPC favorability before the second round of closed testing. This can ensure that we have a higher 'starting point' than other players in the second round of closed testing."
After a pause, Fang Chang snapped his fingers.
"I propose to form a team!"
"The meaning of forming a team is..." Ye Shi asked doubtfully.
Lao Bai nodded.
"I have no problem with that."
Kuangfeng also nodded.
"I agree too."
Ye Shi said dumbly.
"I have no objection, but can you explain to me the details of team formation?"
Fang Chang explained patiently.
"To put it simply, from now on we are a team, sharing intelligence and helping each other. Then, all we have to do is to use our respective strengths."
Fang Chang looked at Kuang Feng and Ye Shi and continued.
"Blast, Ye Shi, you will scout along the lakeshore of the Wetland Park. Pay attention to the distribution and activity tracks of the alien species. If you find a suspected nest area, mark it...but the water spot."
Storm nodded.
"Okay."
Then, Fang Chang looked at Lao Bai.
"As for us, all we have to do now is chop more wood."
"When it goes offline in a while, I will check some information online and find a way to use the wood I have stored up tomorrow!"
